source_caption:
Get Rich or Die Tryin’ (2005)

50 Cent’s album “Guess Who’s Back” serves as a retelling of the events portrayed in the film. On the track “Ghetto Qu’ran,” he details how everything unfolded, from Levar’s imprisonment to the shooting that nearly took his own life. Interestingly, Justice is the only character in the movie whose name was not changed from the real-life story.

source_details.synopsis: Get Rich or Die Tryin' is a 2005 American crime drama film directed by Jim Sheridan and written by Terence Winter. It stars Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson in his feature film acting debut, alongside Terrence Howard, Joy Bryant, Bill Duke, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Omar Benson Miller, Ashley Walters, and Viola Davis. The film, which contains autobiographical elements from 50 Cent's life, follows his character, Marcus Grier, a drug dealer who turns away from his criminal life to pursue his passion of rap music. The film's title is shared with 50 Cent's 2003 debut album of the same name. Plans for a film starring 50 Cent were revealed in 2004, following the success of the Get Rich or Die Tryin' album
